items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: It's like you had gone to the Cotton Club, and maybe it wasn't Jimmy Dorsey, but somebody that was a big leader, and you were able to come in and set in with them for a number or two. Do you remember that?

ctx.x: I can't think of them, name them.

It's like you had gone to the Cotton Club, and maybe it wasn't Jimmy Dorsey, but somebody that was a big leader, and you were able to come in and set in with them for a number or two. Do you remember that?
No, I don't remember. Can't remember the names.
